activity_average_per_person_day.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip New York City travel-cost page; travel cost data last updated May 18, 2026
activity_average_per_person_day.sourceTitle: New York City Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to New York City: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
activity_average_per_person_day.evidenceText: Sightseeing activities, entertainment, and entrance tickets in New York City typically cost an average of $180 per person, per day based on the spending of previous travelers. This includes fees paid for admission tickets to museums and attractions, day tours, and other sightseeing expenses.
activity_average_per_person_day.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com New York City United States travel cost sightseeing activities entertainment entrance tickets per person per day
activity_average_per_person_day.reason: Accepted as an exact New York City activity/entertainment city statistic with explicit per-person-per-day basis. No multiplication or mapping to the two-traveller product value was performed.
